# Build and launcher dependencies

[Tomli](https://github.com/hukkin/tomli) 2.2.1 supplies TOML parsing on the Command Line Tools' Python 3.9; Python 3.11 and newer use the standard library's `tomllib`. Approved for phase 7 on 2026-11-02. The unmodified Python sources come from the [PyPI wheel](https://pypi.org/project/tomli/2.2.1/), `tomli-2.2.1-py3-none-any.whl`, SHA-256 `cb55c73c5f4408779d0cf3eef9f762b9c9f147a77de7b258bef0a5628adc85cc`. Its [MIT license](tomli/LICENSE) stays beside the code. No pip installation is needed on a player's Mac.

[Sparkle](https://sparkle-project.org/) 2.10.1 supplies launcher updates. Its official distribution URL, SHA-256 and public update-signing key are pinned in [sparkle/config.json](sparkle/config.json), with the unmodified [MIT and bundled dependency licenses](sparkle/LICENSE). Launcher builds fetch the verified distribution into an ignored build directory. Generated game apps neither embed the framework nor fetch it while building or playing. Sparkle handles its own UI, EdDSA validation, installation and relaunch; the source kit includes only our integration and configuration.
